title: Overtime
notes: New: Night 6 · Overtime, unlocked once you finish night 5. A new patient, Ziggy the ferret, lives in a pen in the lobby (camera 4).
Ziggy doesn't use the halls. If he turns, he's in the walls: listen for his chitter on the left, the right or the vent, and shut that one fast.
The generator surges on Overtime: every door pops open and the cameras reboot.
Nights: replay any night you've reached and earn up to 3 stars (survive · keep 25% power · nobody turns).
Custom Night challenges (Pack Animals, Birdwatching, Runners, Skeleton Crew), ticked off when you beat them. Ziggy can join Custom Night too.
Patient files: every patient's chart, how many times they got you, and how many correct doses you've given them.
Sync: keep your progress on all your devices (☁ SYNC on the menu).

title: Controllers and phones
notes: Play with a controller: the left stick looks around, the bumpers shut the doors, the triggers work the lights, and A raises the cameras. Menus work with the D-pad.
Play on a phone: drag to look around, tap the buttons along the bottom for the doors, lights and vent, and tap the phone box to answer calls.
More settings: screen shake and flashes (full, reduced or off), auto resolution, fullscreen and controllers. Settings can now be opened from the pause menu.

title: Install as an app
notes: Willowmere After Hours can be installed as an app from the menu (INSTALL AS APP), with its own icon. It opens fullscreen and works offline once it has loaded.

title: Release
notes: Night-shift horror at Willowmere animal hospital: five nights, plus a Custom Night.
Keep Biscuit, Mittens, Hoppy and Pepper calm on the cameras: feed them, play them music, or dose them at the medication station.
Let a patient's stress reach 100 and it turns, and comes for you.
From night 4, the Stray only moves when nobody is watching it.
